messages.subject: how to use Sys.time() condition in conditionalPanel?
messages.subject_clean: how to use Sys.time() condition in conditionalPanel?
messages.body_plain:
Hey Shiny users,

I'm looking for a simple solution to the following problem (I don't think it's supposed to be very hard..)

I want to use time condition using Sys.time() to conditionalPanel.

For example:

conditionalPanel(
  condition = "format(Sys.time(),'%H:%M') >= '18:30'",
  numericInput("num","Number", value = 1, step=1)
)

But, it's not working.

Is there any solution?

Thnaks.
Lee

messages.subject: Caching object in Shiny Server
messages.body_plain:
Hello,

I am using tq_get of tidyquant package to get stock prices of various symbols,but want to cache those prices for the tickers on server. I am not able to find an ideal way. Was reading about memorycache object which seems to suit my  requirements as it can store object in form of value, key pairs, but not able to find any example. Can someone please site an example? I also tried using reactivevalues function, but facing 2 issue's with it. How to store key , value objects and second in case  i want to reset some of the values of object how to do it? Any other ideas appreciated.

messages.subject_clean: highcharter treemap stop working on Shiny Server
messages.body_plain:
Hi all,

Last week, a section of my app that use highcharter treemap suddenly stopped working. All the other highcharter sections like bar graph, line graph are working fine. There are multiple administrator/developers who have access to the server that can update packages on their own. I am wondering if some update packages might be the cause, or I need to update my highcharter package. Below is the output of the sessionInfo() command that I ran on the Linux system that is currently hosting the Shiny Server. Have anyone running into this problem before?
